description: ABOUT US Founded in 1910 in Trivero, Italy, the Ermenegildo Zegna Group (NYSE:ZGN) is a global luxury company with a leading position in the high-end menswear business. Through its three complementary brands, the Group reaches a wide range of communities and market segments across the high-end fashion industry, from ZEGNA’s timeless luxury to the modern tailoring of Thom Browne, to seductive elegance with TOM FORD FASHION. The Ermenegildo Zegna Group is internationally recognized for its unique Filiera, owned and controlled by the Group, which is made up of the finest Italian textile producers fully integrated with unique luxury manufacturing capabilities, ensuring superior excellence, quality, and innovation. The Group employs more than 7,100 people worldwide. YOUR OPPORTUNITY The SAP Business Continuity Service Manager plays a pivotal role within the IT Business Continuity team, ensuring the end‑to‑end stability, integration, and continuity of the SAP S/4HANA platform and the broader application landscape supporting the company’s core business processes. The role requires constant engagement with vertical SAP teams responsible for first‑level Application Management Services (AMS), as well as close collaboration with the SAP CoE Manager to guarantee performance, reliability, and scalability across the SAP ecosystem. The position also oversees external AMS third‑party suppliers and service partners, ensuring alignment with internal standards, operating guidelines, and contractual commitments. In addition, the SAP Business Continuity Service Manager leads an internal Governance team that oversees key operational pillars, including the ServiceNow ticketing platform, account management services, testing automation tools, application transport management, and all end‑user communications related to planned and unplanned maintenance activities. As part of the Business Continuity team, the SAP Service Manager will actively contribute to the SAP RISE migration roadmap, coordinate cross‑functional workstreams, supervise Integration and User Acceptance Testing and ensure seamless alignment between internal stakeholders and external implementation partners. The role will be based in Stabio (Switzerland). HOW YOU BRING IT TO LIFE Provide leadership and oversight for SAP S/4HANA service delivery teams across application modules, interfaces, and hybrid/cloud environments. Lead the Governance team (covering ServiceNow, Testing Automation, Account and Release Management). Coordinate with third‑party suppliers and service partners to maintain process consistency, efficiency, and quality ensuring availability and continuity in line with corporate SLAs. Ensure effective execution and continuous enhancement of Business Continuity processes (Support Request, Incident, Problem, and Change Management), compliant with SOX standards. Manage external vendors and service providers contracts, overseeing KPI performance and contractual compliance through structured review sessions. Support strategic project initiatives by delivering Business Continuity Make‑mode services to other IT teams, ensuring alignment with IT Stream Leaders and the Demand function, and guaranteeing the quality and risk governance of all deliverables. WHO YOU ARE Technical & Professional Skills Strong expertise in SAP S/4HANA, with solid understanding of key functional modules and SAP technical architecture Proven experience managing complex SAP environments, ideally in hybrid and/or cloud-based contexts, with a strong orientation toward service quality Exposure to SAP RISE and/or large SAP transformation or migration programs with a strong innovation mindset Solid knowledge of SAP integrations with external systems (APIs, middleware, EDI, cloud services) Deep familiarity with ITIL practices and enterprise service management frameworks and IT process oversight Experience with ServiceNow ticketing platforms is considered a plus Background in Fashion & Luxury industry is a plus Experience 3–5 years of experience in similar roles within structured corporate IT organizations and/or consulting companies Soft Skills Strong leadership and stakeholder management capabilities Structured, governance-oriented mindset with high attention to service quality Ability to operate effectively in complex, cross-functional environments Proactive, reliable, and comfortable managing multiple priorities Education Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Management Engineering, or other STEM disciplines (equivalent SAP-related experience may be considered) Languages Good knowledge of English, written and spoken Mobility Willingness to travel occasionally for business needs

descriptionByLocale.it: Fondata nel 1910 a Trivero, Italia, il Gruppo Ermenegildo Zegna (NYSE:ZGN) è una società di lusso globale con una posizione di primo piano nel business menswear di fascia alta. Attraverso i suoi tre marchi complementari, il Gruppo raggiunge una vasta gamma di comunità e segmenti di mercato in tutto il settore della moda di fascia alta, dal lusso senza tempo di ZEGNA alla moderna sartoria di Thom Browne, alla seducente eleganza con TOM FORD FASHION. Il Gruppo Ermenegildo Zegna è riconosciuto a livello internazionale per la sua unica Filiera, di proprietà e controllata dal Gruppo, costituito dai migliori produttori tessili italiani pienamente integrati con capacità produttive di lusso uniche, garantendo un'eccellenza, qualità e innovazione superiore. Il Gruppo impiega oltre 7,100 persone in tutto il mondo. TUA OPPORTUNITÀ Il SAP Business Continuity Service Manager svolge un ruolo cardine all’interno del team IT Business Continuity, garantendo la stabilità, l’integrazione e la continuità della piattaforma SAP S/4HANA e il panorama delle applicazioni più ampio che supporta i processi aziendali fondamentali dell’azienda. Il ruolo richiede un costante impegno con i team SAP verticali responsabili dei servizi di gestione delle applicazioni di primo livello (AMS), nonché una stretta collaborazione con SAP CoE Manager per garantire prestazioni, affidabilità e scalabilità in tutto l'ecosistema SAP. La posizione supervisiona anche fornitori e partner di servizi esterni AMS di terze parti, garantendo l'allineamento con gli standard interni, le linee guida operative e gli impegni contrattuali. Inoltre, il SAP Business Continuity Service Manager guida un team di governance interna che supervisiona i principali pilastri operativi, tra cui la piattaforma di ticketing ServiceNow, i servizi di gestione account, gli strumenti di analisi dell'automazione, la gestione dei trasporti delle applicazioni e tutte le comunicazioni degli utenti finali relative alle attività di manutenzione pianificate e non pianificate. Nell'ambito del team Business Continuity, SAP Service Manager contribuirà attivamente alla roadmap di migrazione SAP RISE, coordina i flussi di lavoro interfunzionali, supervisiona l'integrazione e l'accettazione degli utenti e garantisce un allineamento senza interruzioni tra gli stakeholder interni e i partner di implementazione esterni. Il ruolo si baserà a Stabio (Svizzera). Gestione delle competenze e dei sistemi di gestione delle competenze e delle competenze aziendali Lingue - Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, scritta e parlata Mobilità - Volontà di viaggiare occasionalmente per esigenze aziendali

descriptionByLocale.de: Beschreibung ÜBER UNS Gegründet 1910 in Trivero, Italien, ist die Ermenegildo Zegna Group (NYSE:ZGN) ein globales Luxusunternehmen mit einer führenden Position im High-End-Männer-Swear-Geschäft. Durch die drei komplementären Marken erreicht die Gruppe ein breites Spektrum an Kommunen und Marktsegmenten über die High-End-Modebranche, vom zeitlosen Luxus ZEGNA bis hin zur modernen Anpassung von Thom Browne bis hin zur verführerischen Eleganz mit TOM FORD FASHION. Die Ermenegildo Zegna Gruppe ist international anerkannt für ihre einzigartige Filiera, die im Besitz und unter Kontrolle der Gruppe ist, die aus den feinsten italienischen Textilherstellern besteht, die vollständig mit einzigartigen Luxus-Produktionskapazitäten integriert sind, um höchste Exzellenz, Qualität und Innovation zu gewährleisten. Der Konzern beschäftigt weltweit mehr als 7.100 Mitarbeiter. IHRE BERICHT Der SAP Business Continuity Service Manager spielt eine zentrale Rolle innerhalb des IT Business Continuity Teams, um die dauerhafte Stabilität, Integration und Kontinuität der SAP S/4HANA-Plattform und der breiteren Anwendungslandschaft zu gewährleisten, die die Kerngeschäftsprozesse des Unternehmens unterstützt. Die Rolle erfordert ein ständiges Engagement mit vertikalen SAP-Teams, die für First-Level Application Management Services (AMS) verantwortlich sind, sowie eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem SAP CoE Manager, um Leistung, Zuverlässigkeit und Skalierbarkeit im gesamten SAP-Ökosystem zu gewährleisten. Die Position überwacht auch externe AMS-Lieferanten und Servicepartner von Drittanbietern und gewährleistet eine Angleichung an interne Standards, Betriebsleitlinien und vertragliche Verpflichtungen. Darüber hinaus führt der SAP Business Continuity Service Manager ein internes Governance-Team, das die wichtigsten operativen Säulen überwacht, einschließlich der ServiceNow Ticketing-Plattform, Account Management-Services, Testautomatisierungstools, Application Transport Management und allen Endnutzer-Kommunikationen im Zusammenhang mit geplanten und nicht geplanten Wartungsarbeiten. Im Rahmen des Business Continuity-Teams wird der SAP Service Manager aktiv zum SAP RISE Migrationsplan beitragen, funktionsübergreifende Arbeitsabläufe koordinieren, Integration und User Acceptance Testing überwachen und eine nahtlose Ausrichtung zwischen internen Stakeholdern und externen Implementierungspartnern gewährleisten. Die Rolle wird in Stabio (Schweiz) getragen. HOW YOU BRING IT TO LIFE - Führende und Aufsicht für SAP S/4HANA-Services über Anwendungsmodule, Schnittstellen und hybride/Cloud-Umgebungen - Führen Sie das Governance-Team (Covering ServiceNow, Testing Automation, Account and Release Management) Sprachen - Gute Englischkenntnisse, schriftliche und gesprochene Mobilität - Bereitschaft, gelegentlich für Geschäftsbedürfnisse zu reisen
descriptionByLocale.fr: Descrizione À PROPOS DE NOUS Fondé en 1910 à Trivero, en Italie, le groupe Ermenegildo Zegna (NYSE:ZGN) est une entreprise de luxe mondiale avec une position de leader dans l'industrie du vêtement masculin haut de gamme. Grâce à ses trois marques complémentaires, le Groupe rejoint un large éventail de communautés et de segments de marché dans l'industrie de la mode haut de gamme, du luxe intemporel de ZEGNA au tissage moderne de Thom Browne, à l'élégance séduisante avec TOM FORD FASHION. Le Groupe Ermenegildo Zegna est reconnu internationalement pour son Filiera unique, détenu et contrôlé par le Groupe, qui est composé des meilleurs producteurs de textiles italiens entièrement intégrés avec des capacités de fabrication de luxe uniques, assurant une excellence, une qualité et une innovation supérieures. Le Groupe emploie plus de 7 100 personnes dans le monde. VOTRE OPPORTUNITÉ Le gestionnaire de services de continuité des activités SAP joue un rôle central au sein de l'équipe de continuité des activités TI, assurant la stabilité, l'intégration et la continuité de la plateforme SAP S/4HANA et du paysage d'applications plus large qui soutient les processus opérationnels essentiels de l'entreprise. Le rôle exige un engagement constant avec les équipes verticales SAP responsables des Services de gestion des applications (AMS) de premier niveau, ainsi qu'une collaboration étroite avec le gestionnaire du CoE SAP pour garantir la performance, la fiabilité et l'évolutivité de l'écosystème SAP. Le poste supervise également les fournisseurs et partenaires de services externes du SGA, en veillant à l'harmonisation avec les normes internes, les lignes directrices opérationnelles et les engagements contractuels. De plus, le gestionnaire de services de continuité des activités SAP dirige une équipe de gouvernance interne qui supervise les principaux piliers opérationnels, y compris la plate-forme de billetterie ServiceNow, les services de gestion de compte, l'essai des outils d'automatisation, la gestion du transport d'applications et toutes les communications des utilisateurs finals liées aux activités de maintenance planifiées et imprévues. Dans le cadre de l'équipe de continuité des activités, le gestionnaire de services SAP contribuera activement à la feuille de route de migration SAP RISE, coordonnera les flux de travail interfonctionnels, supervisera les tests d'intégration et d'acceptation par les utilisateurs et veillera à ce que les parties prenantes internes et les partenaires externes de mise en œuvre soient en harmonie. Le rôle sera basé à Stabio (Suisse).
